metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Base44 builders, by Daniel Rechtman.

plugins.name: base44-phone-sso
plugins.description: Set up phone-number login (a one-time code on WhatsApp) for a Base44 app, end to end. Deploys a self-hosted OIDC provider on Cloudflare, connects it to Base44 SSO, adds an in-app allowlist, and delivers the code through Green API or Meta's Cloud API with automatic failover.
